about: RC3 bounded tagged byte matcher. These are new seams; no previous package, law or example tests this engine. Seeded AST semantics are tested, not emission authority.

mutants.name: rc3-priority-reversed
mutants.rule: Ordered alternatives and greedy repetition preserve first successful path priority.

mutants.name: rc3-fallback-last-history-only
mutants.to:
if len(events)>2 { return events[len(events)-2:] }; return events
}
mutants.rule: Canonical fallback keeps all capture occurrences and nested event correlation.

mutants.name: rc3-validator-ignores-tag-order
mutants.rule: Construction checks symbolic action identity, not sampled capture values.

mutants.name: rc3-validator-loses-eof
mutants.to: for b, got := range s.edges { if b==256 { continue };
mutants.rule: Every reachable state includes end-of-input in its complete correspondence.

mutants.name: rc3-validator-loses-byte
mutants.to: for b, got := range s.edges { if b==255 { continue };
mutants.rule: All 256 input bytes, including non-ASCII input failure paths, are checked.

mutants.name: rc3-work-exhaustion-is-proof
mutants.rule: A bounded attempt that runs out of work selects NFA, never a proved candidate.

mutants.name: rc3-ambiguous-history-admitted
mutants.from: return nil, work, "competing byte or acceptance histories"
mutants.rule: A deterministic edge cannot merge competing priority histories.

mutants.name: rc3-nullable-repeat-admitted
mutants.rule: Nullable repeated bodies are refused before they can generate unbounded empty history.

mutants.name: rc3-expansion-budget-ignored
mutants.rule: Oversized bounded repetition is refused before materialization.

mutants.name: rc3-dedup-ignores-capture-policy
mutants.rule: Capture identities, mode, byte profile and all-occurrences policy participate in semantic cache identity.

mutants.name: rc3-emitter-drops-actions
mutants.rule: The actual emitted direct action representation is validated before export.

mutants.name: rc3-emitted-driver-truncates-history
mutants.rule: The actual NFA Go driver preserves histories, including paths that cannot be one-pass.

mutants.name: rc4b-find-no-dedup
mutants.rule: A find runs every start in one pass: a thread that reaches a visited instruction is dropped, so work per byte is bounded (Lowering 4).

mutants.name: rc4b-parse-at-off-by-one
mutants.rule: NoMatch.At is the longest prefix that is a prefix of a word, for every engine (The pattern bundle 2).

mutants.name: rc4b-slot-close-swapped
mutants.rule: The emitted typed result keeps each capture's open and close in its own slot (Lowering 3).
